p: my soul waiteth upon God: Though Satan tempted him to murmur against God, yet he bridled his affections, and resting on God's promise.
He only is my rock and: It appears by the often repetition of this word, that the prophet endured many temptations by resting on God and by patience he overcame them all.
man: He means himself, being the man whom God had appointed to the kingdom.
bowing wall shall ye be: Though you seem to be in honour, yet God will suddenly destroy you.
My soul: David was greatly moved by these troubles, therefore he stirs up himself to trust in God.
glory: These vehement and often repetitions were necessary to strengthen his faith against the horrible assault of Satan.
pour out your heart before him: He admonishes us of our wicked nature, which would rather hide our sorrow and bite the bridle, than utter our grief to God to obtain remedy.
become not vain in robbery: Give yourselves wholly to God by putting away all things that are contrary to his law.
once: He has plainly born witness to his power, so that no one needs to doubt it.
renderest to every man according to: So that the wicked will feel your power, and the godly your mercy.
